summary: The traditional way to build AAPS on a computer: install Git and the right Android Studio version, clone the AndroidAPS repository, point Android Studio to Git, and generate a signed APK with a keystore. Quoted and bold labels are Android Studio's, not the app's, so none map to app strings.
